ideas.pitch: A real-time 3D digital twin platform built in collaboration with the Metaverse Association to monitor and optimize energy consumption across smart campuses like KAHE.
ideas.title: MetaCampus 3D Digital Twin & Energy Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the co-organizer Metaverse Association's focus on immersive 3D environments, while utilizing an anomaly detection and visualization pattern proven in campus energy hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based AR/VR environment for immersive regional language and technical skill training tailored for national-level engineering students.
ideas.title: MetaClassroom AR Immersive Language Lab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Metaverse Association partnership theme with an immersive spatial UI that stands out against standard web apps in a national-level presentation.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform utilizing MediaPipe to monitor laboratory and workshop safety compliance, posture ergonomics, and automated incident detection in engineering colleges.
ideas.title: SmartCampus Pose-Tracker Safety Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-performance client-side computer vision with a functional live demo that judges can interact with instantly using their laptop webcams.

ideas.pitch: A real-time multi-agent simulation tool for detecting network anomalies and visualizing DDoS threats in an interactive 3D spatial interface.
ideas.title: NetGuard 3D: Multi-Agent Campus Network Threat Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex systems engineering (multi-agent orchestration) combined with high-impact 3D visualization that appeals to technical engineering faculty judges.

ideas.pitch: A web3-enabled spatial metaverse portal where student developers from across India can customize their virtual project booths and interact in 3D during the online preliminary screening.
ideas.title: Metaverse Student Showcase Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Metaverse Association collaboration theme by providing utility for the hackathon itself during the online preliminary evaluation round.
